page.layout: One block of running text, one paragraph, set in roman with italic place names and words. Above it, the page number and running head at the top. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "DE".
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: fine per Inge formare ; ut Hunsinge, Five-linge, Ostringe, Rustringe, Harlinge, Hu-singe, Esinge : Wetzinge, Thezinge, Thedinge, Appinge, Cortinge, Iemminge, Pauvinge, Baltringe, Schuringe, Mac-kinge, Mitlinge, Tinaldinge, & in ipsâ urbe Ebbinge, Botteringe, Harderinge, Folkeringe, Gaddinge, Gelkinge, ut patronymica infinita ejusdem de-sinentiae in Frisiâ & Drentiâ praeteream.

page.notes: Long s was read as plain s throughout. "Hu-singe" is partly unclear at the line break: the first syllable is clear, the rest reads as "singe" but is marked as doubtful. The circumflexes on ipsâ, Frisiâ and Drentiâ are as printed. The catchword "DE" stands at the right below the last line and is set larger than the text.
